name: 陳儀
objective: This CSP (Chinese for Specific Purposes) course is designed to equip pre-service international students in Taiwan with the Chinese language skills pertinent to semiconductor technology. The program aims to establish a solid foundation by introducing basic Chinese terminology used in the semiconductor industry. Students will receive training in essential technical Chinese terms related to semiconductor processes, equipment, and devices. The course will enhance their Chinese listening and reading skills, which are vital for academic success in advanced engineering disciplines. Through this CSP, future engineers will be prepared for more advanced technical training in high-tech sectors. The CSP will contribute to the future globalization of local high-tech industries.

remarks:
1. Throughout the semester, the course focuses on Semiconductor Technology, aligning with SDG 4, “Quality Education.”

2. The course schedule for Weeks 10–17 includes technology-related reading, writing, and project presentations. These activities are designed to train students to think critically about contemporary technological developments and issues. This component of the course corresponds to the second dimension of Innovative Character Education, “Inspiring Critical Thinking” (Explanation).
